persistent.description: If true the host is always shown even if it has not been active since the Freebox startup

primary_name.description: Host primary name (chosen from the list of available names, or manually set by user)

primary_name_manual.description: If true the primary name has been set manually

reachable.description: If true the host can receive traffic from the Freebox

vendor_name.description: Host vendor name (from the mac address)

hostname.description: Name of the target host in the local network

id.description: Unique identifier of the port forwarding

port_range_end.description: End boundary of the port range to forward. If not set, it will default to the same value as `port_range_start`.

port_range_start.description: Start boundary of the port range to forward. The range is inclusive.

source_ip.description: Local IP of the local port forwarding target. If left unset or set to 0.0.0.0, the rule will apply to any incoming IP

target_ip.description: Local IP of the local port forwarding target

target_port.description: The target port range to forward to. If not set, it will default to the same value as `port_range_start`. Only available for a range of 1 port.

block.description:
Manages a port forwarding between a local network host and the Freebox Internet Gateway.

bind_usb_ports.description: List of ports that should be bound to this VM. Only one VM can use USB at given time, whether is uses only one or all USB ports. The list of system USB ports is available in VmSystemInfo. For example: `usb-external-type-a`, `usb-external-type-c`

cd_path.description: Path to CDROM device ISO image

cloudinit_hostname.description: When cloudinit is enabled, hostname desired for this VM.

cloudinit_userdata.description: When cloudinit is enabled, raw YAML to be passed in the user-data file.

disk_path.description: Path to the hard disk image of this VM

enable_cloudinit.description: Whether or not to enable passing data through `cloudinit`. This uses the NoCloud iso image method; it will add a virtual CDROM drive (distinct from the one passed by `cd_path`) with the data in `cloudinit_userdata` and `cloudinit_hostname` when enabled

os.description: Type of OS used for this VM. Only used to set an icon for now

kill.description: Duration to wait for a graceful shutdown before force killing the virtual machine (default: `"30s"`)

networking.description: Duration to wait for the virtual machine to appear on the network (default: `"1m"`)

timeouts.description: Timeouts for various operations expressed as strings such as `30s` or `2h45m` where valid time units are `s` (seconds), `m` (minutes) and `h` (hours)

vcpus.description: Number of virtual CPUs to allocate to this VM
